title: December 5, 2023 Austin City Council 12:00 PM - Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL  
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
 TUESDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2023 AT 12:00 PM 
AUSTIN CITY HALL  
301 W. SECOND STREET AUSTIN, TX 
 
 
Press Conference 
 
Attend a press conference hosted by Council Members Leslie Pool and Josè “Chito” Vela discussing 
City Code amendments relating to the number of housing units on a lot and occupancy limits 
(HOME amendments). 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
